title: Twitch GTA 6 ads: new tech to help streamers earn more
description: Twitch GTA 6 ads get new brand-safety tech before the November 19 launch, and it could help streamers earn more, according to Dexerto's report.

body.text: Twitch GTA 6 ads are getting a technical overhaul just ahead of the game's November 19 launch. According to Dexerto, Twitch has built new ad technology that lets advertisers avoid specific parts of the game they don't want to be linked with. The goal is to help streamers earn more while playing a mature-rated title, which matters because GTA has long been a weak spot for ad revenue on the platform.
How Twitch GTA 6 ads will work

CEO Dan Clancy shared the details in a Bloomberg interview on November 12, one week before launch. He said Twitch had "spent a lot of time making sure that our creators can monetize effectively" and had worked closely with advertisers who want to be part of the launch.

The core problem, in his words, is that brands want to be involved in the GTA 6 launch but are wary of certain content. Twitch's tech means that any section of the game an advertiser doesn't want to be associated with won't carry their ads. Clancy described this as giving brands a chance to be part of the moment, and he expects the launch to be "one of the biggest moments on Twitch."
Why GTA streamers were unhappy with ad revenue

Dexerto points to comments from streamer Nmplol in September, who claimed advertisers had pulled back from the GTA category entirely. He said ad revenue on all of GTA was pulled two years ago and that it remains that way today.
He also claimed that xQc's GTA ad revenue was "probably peanuts" compared with one of his Just Chatting streams. These are one streamer's claims, not figures confirmed by Twitch.

Dexerto adds that GTA streamers have been leaving for rival platform Kick for years. The most notable is Buddha, a huge name in GTA RP, who has streamed almost exclusively on Kick for the past four years.
GTA RP comeback and the online question
Clancy also expects roleplay to return in a big way. He said GTA RP "was huge on Twitch" and is "going to kind of be reinvigorated" in January, February and March.
There is one big unknown. Clancy said Twitch has "no idea" when Rockstar will launch GTA 6's online multiplayer, so the roleplay boost depends on timing that is still unclear.

The real test comes on and after November 19. Watch whether big advertisers actually show up on GTA 6 streams, and whether streamers report a visible jump in earnings compared with previous GTA titles. Also keep an eye on whether GTA creators who left for Kick consider coming back, and on any word from Rockstar about online multiplayer. For Indian viewers and creators, it will show whether mature-rated games can become a reliable income source on Twitch.

faqs.q: What is Twitch changing for GTA 6 ads?
faqs.a: According to Dexerto, Twitch has built technology that lets advertisers keep their ads away from parts of GTA 6 they don't want to be associated with. The aim is to get more brands on board and help streamers earn more.

faqs.q: When does GTA 6 launch and when did Twitch announce the ad change?
faqs.a: Dexerto reports that GTA 6 launches on November 19. Twitch CEO Dan Clancy revealed the change in a Bloomberg interview on November 12.

faqs.q: Why was GTA ad revenue a problem for Twitch streamers?
faqs.a: Streamer Nmplol claimed in September that advertisers had pulled back from the GTA category entirely, and said xQc's GTA ad revenue was probably "peanuts" next to a Just Chatting stream. Dexerto notes that GTA streamers have also been leaving for Kick for years.

sources.title: Twitch makes huge ad change so streamers can make more money while playing GTA 6
